title: Always start your prompt with the type of shot (e.g., extreme wide shot, close-up, medium shot, POV) because Seedance...
content:
---
Always start your prompt with the type of shot (e.g., extreme wide shot, close-up, medium shot, POV) because Seedance respects it almost 100%.  
Use explicit slow motion with high FPS (e.g., 120fps ultra slow motion) to intensify emotions in Seedance 2.0.  
Combine POV + handheld shaky cam to achieve a total immersion feeling in action scenes.  
Add dust particles or smoke in the prompt to give atmospheric depth to the scene.  
Include long take to indicate to Seedance not to cut, ideal for dialogue scenes.  
Use long lens compression to flatten space and achieve classic western aesthetics.  
In horror prompts, avoid mentioning monsters and focus on atmosphere (empty hallways, flickering lights, silence) so that the fear comes from what is not seen.  
Add bokeh to isolate characters and create visual intimacy in romantic scenes.  
Include observational style to activate more organic camera movement in documentary style.  
For a noir look, specify high contrast black and white for better results.  
In war scenes, prioritize close-ups of details (hands, objects, photos) instead of explosions to generate more emotion.  
Include end credits feel for Seedance to generate a movement with a cinematic closing cadence.  
Structure your prompts with this formula: Type of shot + Action/Subject + Light/Environment + Camera movement + Color palette + FPS/Style.

--- THREAD CONTINUATION ---
[Thread 1] 1: The Epic Opening
Scene type: Action movie opening

"Extreme wide shot of a dystopian megacity at dawn, thick orange smog, flying vehicles crossing between skyscrapers, slow drone descend towards street level, cinematic color grading, anamorphic lens flare, 24fps film grain"

💡 Key: always start with the type of shot. Seedance respects it almost 100%.

[Thread 2] 2: The Psychological Thriller
Scene type: Interior tension

"Close-up of a woman's eye reflecting flickering candlelight, single tear slowly falling, shallow depth of field, cold blue tones, barely audible breathing, ultra slow motion 120fps, noir lighting"

💡 Slow motion in Seedance 2.0 is brutal. Use it for emotions.

[Thread 3] 3: The Urban Chase
Scene type: Street action

"POV chase through narrow Tokyo alleyways at night, rain-soaked neon reflections on asphalt, handheld shaky cam, motion blur, protagonist breathing heard, red and cyan color palette, 30fps"

💡 POV + handheld = total immersion feeling. Works perfectly in Seedance.

[Thread 4] 4: The Historical Drama
Scene type: Victorian era

"Medium shot of a Victorian gentleman reading a letter by candlelight in a dark library, dust particles floating in the air, golden hour lighting through curtains, slow zoom in, desaturated warm tones, 24fps"

💡 Add "dust particles" or "smoke" to give atmospheric depth to the scene.

[Thread 5] 5: The Intimate Sci-Fi
Scene type: Sci-fi drama

"Two astronauts floating in silence inside a damaged space station, emergency red lighting, Earth visible through a cracked porthole, medium two-shot, long take, no music, ambient hum, cinematic 2.39:1 ratio"

💡 "Long take" indicates to Seedance not to cut. Ideal for dialogue scenes.

[Thread 6] 6: The Modern Western
Scene type: Neo-western

"Lone cowboy silhouette walking through dusty desert at golden hour, camera slowly pulling back to reveal vast landscape, long lens compression, heat shimmer, Ennio Morricone style framing, 24fps"

💡 "Long lens compression" flattens space and creates that classic western aesthetic.

[Thread 7] 7: The Atmospheric Horror
Scene type: Psychological terror

"Empty hospital corridor at 3am, flickering fluorescent light at the end of the hall, static camera, slow zoom, complete silence, desaturated green tones, slight film grain, 24fps"

💡 Never put monsters in the prompt. The real horror is in what is NOT seen.

[Thread 8] 8: The Cinematic Romance
Scene type: Romantic drama

"Two people sharing an umbrella in the rain on a Paris bridge at night, city lights reflected on wet cobblestones, soft bokeh background, slow dolly shot, warm amber tones, 24fps film look"

💡 "Bokeh" is your best ally to isolate characters and create visual intimacy.

[Thread 9] 9: The Urban Documentary
Scene type: Fictional documentary

"Handheld medium shot following a street vendor through a crowded Mumbai market at midday, natural sunlight, ambient noise, authentic crowd movement, desaturated realist color grade, observational style"

💡 "Observational style" activates more organic camera movement in Seedance.

[Thread 10] 10: The Underwater Sequence
Scene type: Adventure

"Underwater shot of a diver exploring a sunken shipwreck, rays of light piercing the ocean surface, slow motion bubbles, teal and deep blue tones, calm drift movement, 60fps slowed to 24fps"

💡 Underwater scenes are where Seedance 2.0 shows its greatest leap compared to v1.

[Thread 11] 11: The Urban Noir
Scene type: Crime

"Detective standing under a streetlamp in the rain at midnight, cigarette smoke curling upward, hard shadows, high contrast black and white, low angle shot looking up, 1940s film noir aesthetic"

💡 "High contrast black and white" in Seedance gives incredible results. Don't underestimate it.

[Thread 12] 12: The Intimate War
Scene type: Dramatic war

"Extreme close-up of a soldier's muddy hands trembling while holding a worn photograph, trench background out of focus, golden hour light, shallow DOF, absolute silence, 120fps ultra slow motion"

💡 In war scenes, close-ups of details generate more emotion than explosions.

[Thread 13] 13: The Movie Ending
Scene type: Epic closure

"Aerial crane shot rising above a city skyline at dusk, character standing alone on a rooftop becoming smaller as camera ascends, epic orchestral score implied, golden and purple sky, 24fps, cinematic end credits feel"

💡 "End credits feel" tells Seedance to generate that movement with a closing cadence.

[Thread 14] The Winning Structure

All these prompts have the same formula:

Type of shot + Action/Subject + Light/Environment + Camera movement + Color palette + FPS/Style

Copy it. Apply it to any scene you imagine.

[Thread 15] Seedance 2.0 is not a tool for someone who writes "a cool video of a city".

It's a tool for someone who thinks like a director.

Start speaking its language and the results will surprise you.

Save this thread 🔖 and tag someone using AI to create content.

Commence toujours ton prompt avec le type de plan (par exemple, extreme wide shot, close-up, medium shot, POV) car Seedance le respecte presque à 100%.

Ajoute dust particles ou smoke dans le prompt pour donner une profondeur atmosphérique à la scène.  
Inclue long take pour indiquer à Seedance de ne pas faire de coupures, idéal pour les scènes de dialogue.  
Utilise long lens compression pour aplatir l'espace et obtenir une esthétique western classique.  
Dans les prompts d'horreur, évite de mentionner des monstres et concentre-toi sur l'atmosphère (couloirs vides, lumières clignotantes, silence) pour que la peur vienne de ce qui n'est pas visible.  
Ajoute bokeh pour isoler les personnages et créer une intimité visuelle dans les scènes romantiques.  
Inclue observational style pour activer un mouvement de caméra plus organique en style documentaire.  
Pour un look noir, spécifie high contrast black and white pour obtenir de meilleurs résultats.  
Dans les scènes de guerre, privilégie les gros plans de détails (mains, objets, photos) plutôt que les explosions pour générer plus d'émotion.  
Inclue end credits feel pour que Seedance génère un mouvement avec une cadence de clôture cinématographique.

ja.title: 常にプロンプトをショットの種類（例：extreme wide shot、close-up、medium shot、POV）で始めてください。Seedanceはこれをほぼ100%尊重します
ja.content:
---
常にプロンプトをショットの種類（例：extreme wide shot、close-up、medium shot、POV）で始めてください。Seedanceはこれをほぼ100%尊重します。  
高FPS（例：120fps ultra slow motion）でスローモーションを明示的に使用し、Seedance 2.0で感情を強調します。  
POV + handheld shaky camを組み合わせて、アクションシーンで完全な没入感を実現します。  
プロンプトにdust particlesやsmokeを追加して、シーンに大気の深みを与えます。  
long takeを含めて、Seedanceにカットしないよう指示し、対話シーンに最適です。  
long lens compressionを使用して、空間を平坦化し、クラシックな西部劇の美学を実現します。  
ホラーのプロンプトでは、モンスターを避け、雰囲気（空っぽの廊下、点滅するライト、静寂）に焦点を当て、見えないものから恐怖を引き出します。  
bokehを追加して、キャラクターを隔離し、ロマンチックなシーンで視覚的な親密さを作り出します。  
observational styleを含めて、ドキュメンタリースタイルでより有機的なカメラの動きを活性化します。  
ノワールの外観には、high contrast black and whiteを指定して、より良い結果を得ます。  
戦争シーンでは、爆発よりもディテール（手、物、写真）のクローズアップを優先して、より多くの感情を生み出します。  
end credits feelを含めて、Seedanceに映画の終わりのカデンツァを持つ動きを生成させます。  
プロンプトを次の公式で構成します：ショットの種類 + アクション/被写体 + 光/環境 + カメラの動き + カラーパレット + FPS/スタイル。

항상 프롬프트를 시작할 때는 촬영 유형(예: extreme wide shot, close-up, medium shot, POV)을 먼저 적으세요. Seedance는 이를 거의 100% 반영합니다.  
Seedance 2.0에서 감정을 강화하기 위해 높은 FPS(예: 120fps ultra slow motion)를 사용하여 슬로우 모션을 명시하세요.  
POV + handheld shaky cam을 결합하여 액션 장면에서 완전한 몰입감을 얻으세요.  
프롬프트에 dust particles 또는 smoke를 추가하여 장면에 대기 깊이를 더하세요.  
long take를 포함하여 Seedance가 컷을 하지 않도록 지시하세요. 대화 장면에 이상적입니다.  
long lens compression을 사용하여 공간을 평평하게 하고 클래식한 서부 영화 미학을 얻으세요.  
공포 프롬프트에서는 괴물을 언급하지 말고 분위기(빈 복도, 깜박이는 불빛, 침묵)에 집중하여 보이지 않는 것에서 공포가 오도록 하세요.  
bokeh를 추가하여 캐릭터를 고립시키고 로맨틱한 장면에서 시각적 친밀감을 만드세요.  
observational style을 포함하여 다큐멘터리 스타일의 더 유기적인 카메라 움직임을 활성화하세요.  
noir 느낌을 원할 때는 high contrast black and white를 지정하여 더 나은 결과를 얻으세요.  
전쟁 장면에서는 폭발 대신 디테일한 클로즈업(손, 물건, 사진)을 우선시하여 더 많은 감정을 생성하세요.  
end credits feel을 포함하여 Seedance가 영화적 마무리의 리듬을 가진 움직임을 생성하도록 하세요.  
프롬프트를 다음 공식으로 구조화하세요: 촬영 유형 + 액션/주제 + 조명/환경 + 카메라 움직임 + 색상 팔레트 + FPS/스타일.

"Handheld medium shot following a street vendor through a crowded Mumbai market at midday, natural sunlight, ambient noise, authentic crowd movement, desaturated realist color grade, observational style"

💡 "Observational style"은 Seedance에서 더 유기적인 카메라 움직임을 활성화합니다.

[Thread 10] 10: 수중 시퀀스

"Underwater shot of a diver exploring a sunken shipwreck, rays of light piercing the ocean surface, slow motion bubbles, teal and deep blue tones, calm drift movement, 60fps slowed to 24fps"

💡 수중 장면은 Seedance 2.0이 v1에 비해 가장 큰 도약을 보여주는 곳입니다.

[Thread 11] 11: 도시 누아르
장면 유형: 경찰 드라마

"Detective standing under a streetlamp in the rain at midnight, cigarette smoke curling upward, hard shadows, high contrast black and white, low angle shot looking up, 1940s film noir aesthetic"

💡 "High contrast black and white"는 Seedance에서 놀라운 결과를 제공합니다. 과소평가하지 마세요.

[Thread 12] 12: 친밀한 전쟁
장면 유형: 전쟁 드라마

"Extreme close-up of a soldier's muddy hands trembling while holding a worn photograph, trench background out of focus, golden hour light, shallow DOF, absolute silence, 120fps ultra slow motion"

💡 전쟁 장면에서는 디테일한 클로즈업이 폭발보다 더 많은 감정을 생성합니다.

[Thread 13] 13: 영화의 끝
장면 유형: 서사적 마무리

"Aerial crane shot rising above a city skyline at dusk, character standing alone on a rooftop becoming smaller as camera ascends, epic orchestral score implied, golden and purple sky, 24fps, cinematic end credits feel"

이 모든 프롬프트는 동일한 공식을 가지고 있습니다:

촬영 유형 + 액션/주제 + 조명/환경 + 카메라 움직임 + 색상 팔레트 + FPS/스타일

복사하세요. 상상하는 모든 장면에 적용하세요.

[Thread 15] Seedance 2.0은 "a cool video of a city"를 쓰는 사람을 위한 도구가 아닙니다.

감독처럼 생각하는 사람을 위한 도구입니다.

그들의 언어로 말하기 시작하면 결과가 놀라울 것입니다.

이 스레드를 저장하고, 콘텐츠를 만들기 위해 AI를 사용하는 사람을 태그하세요.

pt-BR.title: Sempre comece seu prompt com o tipo de plano (por exemplo, extreme wide shot, close-up, medium shot, POV) porque o Se...
pt-BR.content:
---

Sempre comece seu prompt com o tipo de plano (por exemplo, extreme wide shot, close-up, medium shot, POV) porque o Seedance respeita isso quase 100%.  
Use slow motion explícito com FPS altos (por exemplo, 120fps ultra slow motion) para intensificar emoções no Seedance 2.0.  
Combine POV + handheld shaky cam para alcançar uma sensação de imersão total em cenas de ação.  
Adicione dust particles ou smoke no prompt para dar profundidade atmosférica à cena.  
Inclua long take para indicar ao Seedance que não faça cortes, ideal para cenas de diálogo.  
Use long lens compression para achatar o espaço e conseguir a estética clássica de western.  
Em prompts de horror, evite mencionar monstros e foque na atmosfera (corredores vazios, luzes piscando, silêncio) para que o medo venha do que não se vê.  
Adicione bokeh para isolar personagens e criar intimidade visual em cenas românticas.  
Inclua observational style para ativar um movimento de câmera mais orgânico em estilo documental.  
Para look noir, especifique high contrast black and white para obter melhores resultados.  
Em cenas de guerra, priorize primeiros planos de detalhes (mãos, objetos, fotos) em vez de explosões para gerar mais emoção.  
Inclua end credits feel para que o Seedance gere um movimento com cadência de fechamento cinematográfico.  
Estruture seus prompts com esta fórmula: Tipo de plano + Ação/Sujeito + Luz/Ambiente + Movimento de câmera + Paleta de cores + FPS/Estilo.

--- CONTINUAÇÃO DO TÓPICO ---
[Tópico 1] 1: A abertura épica  
Tipo de cena: Abertura de filme de ação

"Extreme wide shot of a dystopian megacity at dawn, thick orange smog, flying vehicles crossing between skyscrapers, slow drone descend towards street level, cinematic color grading, anamorphic lens flare, 24fps film grain"

💡 Dica: sempre comece com o tipo de plano. O Seedance respeita isso quase 100%.

[Tópico 2] 2: O thriller psicológico  
Tipo de cena: Tensão interior

"Close-up of a woman's eye reflecting flickering candlelight, single tear slowly falling, shallow depth of field, cold blue tones, barely audible breathing, ultra slow motion 120fps, noir lighting"

💡 O slow motion no Seedance 2.0 é brutal. Use-o para as emoções.

[Tópico 3] 3: A perseguição urbana  
Tipo de cena: Ação de rua

"POV chase through narrow Tokyo alleyways at night, rain-soaked neon reflections on asphalt, handheld shaky cam, motion blur, protagonist breathing heard, red and cyan color palette, 30fps"

💡 POV + handheld = sensação de imersão total. Funciona perfeitamente no Seedance.

[Tópico 4] 4: O drama histórico  
Tipo de cena: Época vitoriana

"Medium shot of a Victorian gentleman reading a letter by candlelight in a dark library, dust particles floating in the air, golden hour lighting through curtains, slow zoom in, desaturated warm tones, 24fps"

💡 Adicione "dust particles" ou "smoke" para dar profundidade atmosférica à cena.

[Tópico 5] 5: A ficção científica intimista  
Tipo de cena: Drama sci-fi

"Two astronauts floating in silence inside a damaged space station, emergency red lighting, Earth visible through a cracked porthole, medium two-shot, long take, no music, ambient hum, cinematic 2.39:1 ratio"

💡 "Long take" indica ao Seedance que não corte. Ideal para cenas de diálogo.

[Tópico 6] 6: O western moderno  
Tipo de cena: Neo-western

"Lone cowboy silhouette walking through dusty desert at golden hour, camera slowly pulling back to reveal vast landscape, long lens compression, heat shimmer, Ennio Morricone style framing, 24fps"

💡 "Long lens compression" achata o espaço e cria essa estética clássica de western.

[Tópico 7] 7: O horror atmosférico  
Tipo de cena: Terror psicológico

"Empty hospital corridor at 3am, flickering fluorescent light at the end of the hall, static camera, slow zoom, complete silence, desaturated green tones, slight film grain, 24fps"

💡 Nunca coloque monstros no prompt. O horror real está no que NÃO se vê.

[Tópico 8] 8: O romance cinematográfico  
Tipo de cena: Drama romântico

"Two people sharing an umbrella in the rain on a Paris bridge at night, city lights reflected on wet cobblestones, soft bokeh background, slow dolly shot, warm amber tones, 24fps film look"

💡 "Bokeh" é seu melhor aliado para isolar personagens e criar intimidade visual.

[Tópico 9] 9: O documentário urbano  
Tipo de cena: Documentário ficcional

"Handheld medium shot following a street vendor through a crowded Mumbai market at midday, natural sunlight, ambient noise, authentic crowd movement, desaturated realist color grade, observational style"

💡 "Observational style" ativa no Seedance um movimento de câmera mais orgânico.

[Tópico 10] 10: A sequência submarina  
Tipo de cena: Aventura

"Underwater shot of a diver exploring a sunken shipwreck, rays of light piercing the ocean surface, slow motion bubbles, teal and deep blue tones, calm drift movement, 60fps slowed to 24fps"

💡 As cenas submarinas são onde o Seedance 2.0 mostra seu maior salto em relação à v1.

[Tópico 11] 11: O noir urbano  
Tipo de cena: Policial

"Detective standing under a streetlamp in the rain at midnight, cigarette smoke curling upward, hard shadows, high contrast black and white, low angle shot looking up, 1940s film noir aesthetic"

💡 "High contrast black and white" no Seedance dá resultados incríveis. Não subestime.

[Tópico 12] 12: A guerra íntima  
Tipo de cena: Bélico dramático

"Extreme close-up of a soldier's muddy hands trembling while holding a worn photograph, trench background out of focus, golden hour light, shallow DOF, absolute silence, 120fps ultra slow motion"

💡 Em cenas de guerra, os primeiros planos de detalhes geram mais emoção que as explosões.

[Tópico 13] 13: O final de filme  
Tipo de cena: Encerramento épico

"Aerial crane shot rising above a city skyline at dusk, character standing alone on a rooftop becoming smaller as camera ascends, epic orchestral score implied, golden and purple sky, 24fps, cinematic end credits feel"

💡 "End credits feel" diz ao Seedance para gerar esse movimento com cadência de encerramento.

[Tópico 14] A estrutura vencedora

Todos esses prompts têm a mesma fórmula:

Tipo de plano + Ação/Sujeito + Luz/Ambiente + Movimento de câmera + Paleta de cores + FPS/Estilo

Copie. Aplique a qualquer cena que imaginar.

[Tópico 15] Seedance 2.0 não é uma ferramenta para quem escreve "um vídeo legal de uma cidade".

É uma ferramenta para quem pensa como diretor.

Comece a falar o idioma dele e os resultados vão te surpreender.

Guarde este tópico 🔖 e marque alguém que esteja usando IA para criar conteúdo.

zh-CN.title: 始终以镜头类型开始你的prompt（例如，extreme wide shot, close-up, medium shot, POV），因为Seedance几乎100%遵循
zh-CN.content:
---
始终以镜头类型开始你的prompt（例如，extreme wide shot, close-up, medium shot, POV），因为Seedance几乎100%遵循。  
使用高FPS的slow motion（例如，120fps ultra slow motion）在Seedance 2.0中增强情感。  
结合POV + handheld shaky cam以在动作场景中实现完全沉浸感。  
在prompt中添加dust particles或smoke以增加场景的气氛深度。  
包括long take以指示Seedance不进行剪切，非常适合对话场景。  
使用long lens compression来压缩空间，获得经典的西部美学。  
在恐怖题材的prompts中，避免提及怪物，专注于氛围（空荡的走廊、闪烁的灯光、寂静），让恐惧来自于看不见的东西。  
添加bokeh以隔离角色并在浪漫场景中创造视觉亲密感。  
包括observational style以激活更有机的纪录片风格的摄像机运动。  
对于noir风格，指定high contrast black and white以获得更好的效果。  
在战争场景中，优先拍摄细节的特写（手、物品、照片）而不是爆炸，以产生更多情感。  
包括end credits feel以让Seedance生成具有电影结束节奏的运动。  
用这个公式构建你的prompts：镜头类型 + 动作/主体 + 光线/环境 + 摄像机运动 + 色彩调色板 + FPS/风格。

--- 线程延续 ---
[Thread 1] 1: 史诗般的开场
场景类型：动作电影开场

"Extreme wide shot of a dystopian megacity at dawn, thick orange smog, flying vehicles crossing between skyscrapers, slow drone descend towards street level, cinematic color grading, anamorphic lens flare, 24fps film grain"

💡 关键：始终以镜头类型开始。Seedance几乎100%遵循。

[Thread 2] 2: 心理惊悚片
场景类型：内心紧张

"Close-up of a woman's eye reflecting flickering candlelight, single tear slowly falling, shallow depth of field, cold blue tones, barely audible breathing, ultra slow motion 120fps, noir lighting"

💡 Seedance 2.0中的slow motion非常强大。用它来表现情感。

[Thread 3] 3: 城市追逐
场景类型：街头动作

"POV chase through narrow Tokyo alleyways at night, rain-soaked neon reflections on asphalt, handheld shaky cam, motion blur, protagonist breathing heard, red and cyan color palette, 30fps"

💡 POV + handheld = 完全沉浸感。在Seedance中效果完美。

[Thread 4] 4: 历史剧
场景类型：维多利亚时代

"Medium shot of a Victorian gentleman reading a letter by candlelight in a dark library, dust particles floating in the air, golden hour lighting through curtains, slow zoom in, desaturated warm tones, 24fps"

💡 添加“dust particles”或“smoke”以增加场景的气氛深度。

[Thread 5] 5: 内心科幻
场景类型：科幻剧

"Two astronauts floating in silence inside a damaged space station, emergency red lighting, Earth visible through a cracked porthole, medium two-shot, long take, no music, ambient hum, cinematic 2.39:1 ratio"

💡 “Long take”指示Seedance不进行剪切。非常适合对话场景。

[Thread 6] 6: 现代西部
场景类型：新西部

"Lone cowboy silhouette walking through dusty desert at golden hour, camera slowly pulling back to reveal vast landscape, long lens compression, heat shimmer, Ennio Morricone style framing, 24fps"

💡 “Long lens compression”压缩空间，创造经典的西部美学。

[Thread 7] 7: 氛围恐怖
场景类型：心理恐怖

"Empty hospital corridor at 3am, flickering fluorescent light at the end of the hall, static camera, slow zoom, complete silence, desaturated green tones, slight film grain, 24fps"

[Thread 8] 8: 电影浪漫
场景类型：浪漫剧

"Two people sharing an umbrella in the rain on a Paris bridge at night, city lights reflected on wet cobblestones, soft bokeh background, slow dolly shot, warm amber tones, 24fps film look"

[Thread 9] 9: 城市纪录片

"Underwater shot of a diver exploring a sunken shipwreck, rays of light piercing the ocean surface, slow motion bubbles, teal and deep blue tones, calm drift movement, 60fps slowed to 24fps"

[Thread 11] 11: 城市黑色电影
场景类型：警匪片

"Detective standing under a streetlamp in the rain at midnight, cigarette smoke curling upward, hard shadows, high contrast black and white, low angle shot looking up, 1940s film noir aesthetic"

💡 “High contrast black and white”在Seedance中效果惊人。不要低估它。

[Thread 12] 12: 亲密战争
场景类型：战争剧

"Extreme close-up of a soldier's muddy hands trembling while holding a worn photograph, trench background out of focus, golden hour light, shallow DOF, absolute silence, 120fps ultra slow motion"

💡 在战争场景中，细节的特写比爆炸更能产生情感。

[Thread 13] 13: 电影结尾
场景类型：史诗结尾

"Aerial crane shot rising above a city skyline at dusk, character standing alone on a rooftop becoming smaller as camera ascends, epic orchestral score implied, golden and purple sky, 24fps, cinematic end credits feel"

💡 “End credits feel”指示Seedance生成具有结束节奏的运动。

[Thread 14] 获胜结构

所有这些prompts都有相同的公式：

镜头类型 + 动作/主体 + 光线/环境 + 摄像机运动 + 色彩调色板 + FPS/风格

复制它。应用于你想象的任何场景。

[Thread 15] Seedance 2.0不是为那些写“a cool video of a city”的人准备的工具。

它是为那些像导演一样思考的人准备的工具。

开始用他们的语言交流，结果会让你惊喜。

保存这个线程🔖并标记正在使用AI创作内容的人。

es.content:
Empieza siempre tu prompt con el tipo de plano (p. ej., extreme wide shot, close-up, medium shot, POV) porque Seedance lo respeta casi al 100%.  
Usa slow motion explícito con FPS altos (p. ej., 120fps ultra slow motion) para intensificar emociones en Seedance 2.0.  
Combina POV + handheld shaky cam para lograr una sensación de inmersión total en escenas de acción.  
Añade dust particles o smoke en el prompt para dar profundidad atmosférica a la escena.  
Incluye long take para indicarle a Seedance que no haga cortes, ideal para escenas de diálogo.  
Usa long lens compression para aplanar el espacio y conseguir estética western clásica.  
En prompts de horror, evita mencionar monstruos y enfócate en atmósfera (pasillos vacíos, luces parpadeantes, silencio) para que el miedo venga de lo que no se ve.  
Añade bokeh para aislar personajes y crear intimidad visual en escenas románticas.  
Incluye observational style para activar un movimiento de cámara más orgánico en estilo documental.  
Para look noir, especifica high contrast black and white para obtener mejores resultados.  
En escenas bélicas, prioriza primeros planos de detalles (manos, objetos, fotos) en lugar de explosiones para generar más emoción.  
Incluye end credits feel para que Seedance genere un movimiento con cadencia de cierre cinematográfico.  
Estructura tus prompts con esta fórmula: Tipo de plano + Acción/Sujeto + Luz/Entorno + Movimiento de cámara + Paleta de color + FPS/Estilo.
